title: 第1775章 一剑断臂第1774章 真龙洗礼
slug: 纯阳霸体绝美师尊求与我修炼
content_zh:
昏暗的大殿内，湛蓝色的剑光微微闪烁。
苏铭单手提着大自在剑，一句勉强够格，在空旷的石壁间来回回荡。
李狂澜先是愣了一下，以为自己听错了，随即他神识再次一扫，真真切切地感知到了苏铭身上散发出来的源气波动。
星源境三层。
不多不少，就是个星源境。
“哈哈哈哈哈！”
李狂澜仰起头，爆发出一阵肆无忌惮的狂笑，仿佛听到了世间最荒诞的笑话。
“老夫还以为你得了什么通天彻地的造化，搞了半天，只是虚张声势！”
李狂澜干枯的手指指向苏铭，笑得眼泪都快出来了。
站在他身后的七八名李家精锐也是面面相觑，随后跟着哄堂大笑。
“大长老，这小子脑子坏掉了吧？”
“一个星源境三层的杂碎，竟然大言不惭地说要拿半步空源境练手？他知道这两个境界之间隔着多宽的天堑吗？”
“我看他是刚才被真龙残灵吓破了胆，得了失心疯。”
各种毫不掩饰的嘲笑声交织在一起，刺耳至极。
不远处的碎石堆里，浑身是血、衣不蔽体的李暮蝉也听到了这番对话。
她强忍着断骨的剧痛，用双手撑起半个身子，美艳的脸庞此刻因为恶毒而扭曲变形。
“大长老！别跟他废话！直接挑断他的手脚筋！”
李暮蝉歇斯底里地尖叫着，双眼死盯躲在苏铭身后的聂清秋，眼底满是嫉妒与怨毒。
“等会把这小子交给我！我要一点一点敲碎他的骨头！还有聂清秋那个贱人，我要用匕首把她引以为傲的脸蛋划成烂泥，看她以后还怎么在玄龙城装清高！”
李暮蝉脑海中已经浮现出两人跪在地上痛哭求饶的画面，嘴角忍不住裂开一抹残忍的狞笑。

“二小姐放心，老夫这就拿了这小子的狗命，给你们出气！”
李狂澜收敛了笑意，取而代之的是一抹森寒的杀机。
他双手紧握弯曲的赤红战戟，体内半步空源境的源气犹如决堤的洪水般轰然爆发。
轰！
大殿内的青玄石板承受不住这股重压，寸寸龟裂。
“小畜生，下辈子投胎，记得把眼睛擦亮一点！”
李狂澜大喝一声，干瘦的身躯拔地而起，犹如一头下山猛虎。
他手中的战戟裹挟着撕裂空气的音爆声，化作一道长达十几丈的赤红色罡芒，带着泰山压顶之势，直奔苏铭的头顶劈去。
这一击，没有丝毫留手。
李狂澜存了立威的心思，要用最狂暴的手段，将眼前这个不知天高地厚的青年碾成肉泥。
狂风扑面，吹得苏铭的玄黑长袍猎猎作响。
站在后面的聂清秋感受到这毁天灭地般的威压，呼吸停滞，握着长剑的手心满是冷汗。
然而，处于风暴中心的苏铭，连眼皮都没有多抬一下。
他静静地看着迎面劈来的赤红罡芒，握着大自在剑的右手终于动了。
没有花哨的光影，也没有繁复的武技招式。
苏铭只是调动了刚刚蜕变完成的玄龙霸体。
古铜色的右臂上，细密的暗金龙鳞瞬间浮现，紫金色的光晕在鳞片边缘流转。
一股纯粹到令人发指的肉身巨力，顺着手臂灌注进剑身之中。
唰！
苏铭迎着漫天戟影，简简单单地由下至上，撩出了一剑。
content_en:
In the dim hall, the blue sword light flickered slightly.
Su Ming held the Great Freedom Sword in one hand, and his barely qualified words echoed back and forth among the empty stone walls.
Li Kuanglan was stunned for a moment, thinking that he heard wrongly. Then his consciousness swept over again and he truly felt the fluctuations of Origin Qi emanating from Su Ming's body.
The third floor of the Star Source Realm.
Nothing more, nothing less, just a star source realm.
"Hahahahaha!"
Li Kuanglan raised his head and burst into unbridled laughter, as if he had heard the most absurd joke in the world.
"I thought you had some kind of magical power, but after working on it for a long time, it was just a bluff!"
Li Kuanglan pointed his withered finger at Su Ming, laughing so hard that he almost burst into tears.
The seven or eight elite members of the Li family standing behind him also looked at each other, and then burst into laughter.
"Great Elder, has this kid lost his mind?"
"A bastard on the third level of the Star Origin Realm actually brazenly said that he wanted to practice with the Half-Step Sky Origin Realm? Does he know how wide the chasm is between these two realms?"
"I think he was frightened to death by the remnant spirit of the real dragon just now and went crazy."
All kinds of unabashed ridicule intertwined together, which was extremely harsh.
In the rubble not far away, Li Muchan, who was covered in blood and half-clothed, also heard this conversation.
She endured the severe pain of the broken bone and propped up half of her body with her hands. Her beautiful face was now distorted by viciousness.
"Great Elder! Don't talk nonsense to him! Just cut off his limbs!"
Li Muchan screamed hysterically, staring at Nie Qingqiu who was hiding behind Su Ming, his eyes full of jealousy and resentment.
"Leave this kid to me later! I will break his bones bit by bit! And that bitch Nie Qingqiu, I will use a dagger to cut her proud face into mud. Let's see how she can pretend to be aloof in Xuanlong City in the future!"
The image of the two people kneeling on the ground, crying and begging for mercy, had already appeared in Li Muchan's mind, and he couldn't help but reveal a cruel smile at the corner of his mouth.
"Second Miss, don't worry, I'm going to take this kid's life to vent your anger!"
Li Kuanglan suppressed his smile and replaced it with a cold murderous intent.
He held the curved crimson halberd tightly with both hands, and the Origin Qi of the Half-Step Kongyuan Realm in his body burst out like a flood that broke a bank.
boom!
The Qingxuan stone slabs in the main hall could not withstand the heavy pressure and cracked every inch.
"You little beast, remember to keep your eyes open when you are reincarnated in your next life!"
Li Kuanglan shouted loudly, and his thin body rose up from the ground, like a tiger descending from the mountain.
The halberd in his hand was accompanied by a sonic boom that tore the air, and turned into a red light that was more than ten feet long. With the power of a mountain, it struck directly at the top of Su Ming's head.
This attack did not hold back at all.
Li Kuanglan had the intention of establishing his power, and wanted to use the most violent means to crush this ignorant young man in front of him into a pulp.
The strong wind blew against his face, making Su Ming's black robe rustle.
Nie Qingqiu, who was standing behind, felt the overwhelming pressure, his breathing stagnated, and his palms holding the sword were covered in cold sweat.
However, Su Ming, who was at the center of the storm, didn't even raise his eyelids.
He quietly looked at the red light coming towards him, and his right hand holding the Great Freedom Sword finally moved.
There are no fancy lights and shadows, nor complicated martial arts moves.
Su Ming just mobilized the black dragon hegemonic body that had just completed its transformation.
On the bronze right arm, fine dark gold dragon scales appeared instantly, and a purple-gold halo circulated around the edges of the scales.
An outrageously pure physical strength poured down the arm into the sword body.
Uh-huh!
Su Ming faced the shadow of the halberd in the sky and simply raised his sword from bottom to top.
